verses.19:98: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هَلۡ تُحِسُّ مِنۡهُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٍ أَوۡ تَسۡمَعُ لَهُمۡ رِكۡزَۢا

meaning: Rikāz refers to minerals or metals naturally occurring in the earth, like gold or silver extracted from mines. It can also mean buried treasure from pre-Islamic times.
